title: RORAIMA
synopsis: In a mythical world inspired by the ancient landscapes of the Guiana Shield, a young man attempts to climb an impossible mountain. Carrying a burden he refuses to abandon, he embarks on a journey of determination, sacrifice, and self-discovery.

audienceReactions.quote: Wow! I am absolutely blown away by the animation! Seeing what AI is capable of doing today is a little heartbreaking, but at the same time, it gives me hope and makes me realize that I can accomplish so much more on my own.
audienceReactions.author: @ARTISMENTAL

audienceReactions.quote: As a Brazilian, I feel honored. A magnificent display of Mount Roraima. A great film.
audienceReactions.author: @uzielweb

audienceReactions.quote: Thank you for this work about my country. It is refreshing to see a work like this that escapes the cliche of Brazil, Carnival, football and samba.
audienceReactions.author: @fernandafortes3782
